notes.title: 1 BILLION LEVELS! ~ LOOP 1.0.6 UPDATE ~
notes.content:
PROCEDURAL LEVEL GENERATOR!!! 1 BILLION NEW LEVELS!!!
	Please share your favorite level seed numbers that you find!

~~~ BUG FIXES ~~~

Level 100 loops back to level 1 when completed (fixes 'level 101' bug after complete).
Only shows credits once when first complete.
“Continue” button in menu no longer hidden when 100% complete.

RMB locking saved with level progress for continuing later

Clears rmb locks when load or gen a new level part way through the current one

Steam Achievements in game pop up fixed

notes.title: 1.0.5 UPDATE
notes.content:
Right mouse button to LOCK pieces in place (Lock feature not yet included on touch screens)

All levels are now unlocked from the start.

Current Level indicated when on level select screen. (Highlighted in red)

Progress on current level will be saved for later. (Can reset level if select again from menu)

Improved sound code. (No gameplay effect, but might want to adjust your % levels.)

Graphical glitch of Spinner turning a bit too far fixed.

Faster spin and col change (now same speed as swapping)

Menu option “official website” text changed to loopthegame.com for general clarity and awareness.
